workload: NotchShotBenchTranscriptBaseline / NotchShotBenchTranscriptCandidate transcript-window; separate from timing campaign
scope: local release synthetic process, active work sampled; no whole-app or user-journey percentage derived
baseline_observation: Heavy retained stacks pass through ClaudeConversationReader.messages -> NSISO8601DateFormatter.dateFromString -> CFDateFormatterCreateDateFromString -> ICU parsing.
candidate_observation: Substantial remaining stacks pass through ClaudeConversationReader.messages -> Collection.split; timestamp parsing is still present for the retained window.
comparison_limit: Different completed work within two-second sampling windows; do not compare raw sample totals as duration or claim a profiler speedup.

instrument_attempt.tool: xctrace Time Profiler, launch mode, 20-second time limit
instrument_attempt.result: Trace saved but exported time-profile table had zero sample rows; target terminated at time limit. Not used as profiling evidence; ordinary sample captures used instead.

privacy: Only named static frames and tool outcomes retained; raw traces, process metadata and device identifiers remain outside the repository.
